verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is a command-line tool with a documented official CLI. Its docs describe a "scripting-first design for mass batch jobs" and security policies tailored to server environments, so non-interactive, headless use is its native mode. Community reports confirm bash-scripted batch processing of thousands of images and server deployments such as Heroku. missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation or examples (e.g., CI runner or container setup guidance).
